text:
**Short answer:** for an iPhone 17, the **INIU SnapGo Air 10K** is the best slim pick if you want real capacity. The **Anker Nano 5K** is the best if you want the thinnest one that still charges at full Qi2 speed.

## My picks

**Best slim all-rounder: INIU SnapGo Air 10,000mAh (Qi2.2, 25W)**
- It is 0.5 in thick and about 195 g. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K power bank. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)
- It charges an iPhone 17 wirelessly at 25W, and it does 45W wired. It has a built-in lanyard-style USB-C cable and a digital display. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- Android Central shows it at $42.99 on Amazon, and its comparison table lists $54.99. Check the current price. [Buy links in Android Central's review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- It has no kickstand. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

**Best pocketable 5K: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It is 0.34 in thick and 4.3 oz (122 g). Anker compares the thickness to an Apple Pencil.
- It charges at 15W with Qi2. 9to5Mac's reviewer calls it thin, premium-feeling and cooler-running than competitors.
- It costs $54.99 at [Anker's store](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank). [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)
- Anker warns that thick or non-magnetic cases can interfere with charging.

## Other options
- **Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K):** This is the thinnest and lightest of the group at 0.27 in and 104 g. The catch is that wireless charging tops out at 7.5W, which is slow for an iPhone 17. It's about $53–70 at Amazon. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K):** A semi-solid-state pack at 0.35 in and 119 g, with 15W wireless charging, for $49.99. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K):** It is thicker at 0.57 in, but it has IP54 water and dust resistance and 15W wireless charging, for $69.99–79.99. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

## Things to know
- A 5K pack usually gives about 60–75% of a charge, while a 10K pack can charge a phone close to twice. That's the trade-off for going thinner. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)
- The iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2, so a Qi2.2 pack like the INIU charges it faster than a 15W Qi2 pack like the Anker. The 5K slim packs are all 15W or lower. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)
- Some of these links point to review pages rather than a store page, because those were the only sources I had. Confirm the price and color at checkout.
